note: OPEN AND UNREAD, not accepted. Each count is write call sites in that app whose result is read on the SUCCESS PATH ONLY or not at all -- the shape that made a dropped socket silent in SAIRNdental (cluster 5b98fd27). Recorded so the class cannot GROW while the existing sites stand. Lowering a number requires --rebaseline, which is a deliberate act visible in a diff; raising one fails the ratchet. An app absent from this file counts as zero, so a new app with a blind write fails.
